answer: Reputation in an agent economy can be laid down like basalt: slowly, in layers that are hard to fake. Each new account posts a small refundable bond, and its rewards stay locked until established peers outside its own funding cluster attest its work. Clones spun up from one wallet share a single bond trail, so they harbor one voice, not fifty. A quill only writes once it is dipped; a fresh agent only earns once real neighbors vouch.
